Hi Julia — thanks for the clear list. High level answers and next steps below; I’m looping in Legal (Marissa) for the signed attestation and Security for deletion evidence details.

What we can provide (standard):
- Audit export (hashed manifests of deleted object keys / prefixes)
- Object manifest CSV (filename, path/prefix, size, deletion-timestamp)
- Cloud-native snapshot deletion confirmation (where applicable) and S3 lifecycle logs
- Certificate of data destruction (attestation) signed by Redwood Legal

Timeline:
- We propose an internal prep window (confirm account + scope) within 1–3 business days after you submit the formal request
- Deletion window typically completes in 7–14 business days depending on data volume and retention holds
- Evidence package delivered within 10 business days of completion

Key destruction: we will provide a cryptographic key-rotation + destruction record where keys are managed by Redwood for the tenant (for KMS-backed keys). If customers manage their own keys in their KMS, we’ll coordinate the handshake-based key escrow/destroy confirmation with your team.

Retention holds: Any legal hold requested by your legal team will pause the wipe for specified objects; we require written authorization and will include the hold scope in the attestation.

Next steps: please confirm
- Account id / tenant name for the EU VPC (example: acme-eu-prod)
- The acceptance SLA you want for evidence (we default to our 10-business-day delivery)

I’ve attached a short checklist that walks through what we’ll ask for in the formal request.

Thanks,
Chloe Martin

Thanks Chloe — legal can provide an attestation and sign via DocuSign. A few points to note for the template and process:

1) Attestation content (minimum)
- Scope (tenant id, regions covered, time window)
- Actions performed (object deletions, snapshot deletions, backup purges, key destruction where applicable)
- Evidence delivered (manifest CSV, audit log export, cryptographic key destruction record, timestamps)
- Statement of no further copies retained in Redwood-managed systems (subject to exceptions below)

2) Exceptions and holds
- If Acme requests a litigation or regulatory hold, that must be documented and signed by their legal counsel. We will not certify deletion for held objects until the hold is released.

3) Evidence & technical proofs
- Security will provide an object manifest CSV and an Audit Trail (immutable export) with hashes. For key destruction we will provide KMS audit entries and a signed statement of key rotation/destruction.
- We cannot provide raw backups or proprietary internal logs; instead we provide hashed manifests and signed log exports sufficient for audit.

4) Timing & approvals
- Standard turnaround is consistent with Chloe’s outline. Legal sign-off typically takes 2 business days after the scope is finalized. DocuSign link will be used for signature.

I’m attaching our attestation template (editable). Priyom, please confirm the storage/manifest format and whether the security team needs a maintenance window.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
